description.en: A DSH's VS Code-style file manager: browse the current conversation workspace files in the sidebar, edit with the Monaco editor. Tab-based switching, perfect for those who hate having their desktop over-split.
description.zh: DSH 的 VS Code 风格文件管理器：在侧边栏浏览当前对话工作区文件，用 Monaco 编辑器编辑。页签式切换，适合讨厌桌面被过度分割的人。
